name: G3 frameset

editorial.verdict: Best premium race/value frame in the shortlist for buyers who want a proven performance brand without flagship pricing.
caveats: Much more expensive than direct factory frames

purchase_route: Current exact Winspace direct storefront lists US$1,550, selectable 440/460/480/510/540 sizes, add-to-cart and a 10–15 business-day build-to-order lead time. Confirm shipping, tax, stock, warranty and mainland selected checkout before paying.
